_readme: Hand-curated corrections to the effect tags that node/generate-crafting-data.js derives from prose.
Keys are `name|source` in lowercase; values may `add` and/or `remove` tags.
Valid tag names are listed in EFFECT_TAG_GROUPS in node/generate-crafting-data/crafting-effect-tags.js.
Overrides are applied last, so they always win. Re-run `npm run gen:crafting` after editing.
